messages:
Maya R.: heads up — noticed something odd in Console when filtering by org_id. I filtered to org=acme but a few rows show details for org=delta (different org_id in the payload). unsure if UI bug or backend routing issue.
Dan G.: ugh. can you paste the request/response you used? any repro steps?
Maya R.: steps: login as acme-admin -> Console /runs -> set org filter to acme -> page 2 -> observe rows.
Maya R.: response snippet (redacted):
```json
{
  "runs": [
    {"id": "r-123","org_id": "acme","meta": {...}},
    {"id": "r-124","org_id": "delta","meta": {...}}
  ],
  "page": 2
}
```
Sam T.: can you confirm the JWT/org claim for the request? maybe a proxy header override or cached query?
Maya R.: jwt_claims: {"org": "acme"} — I double-checked. no special headers.
Jordan L.: if runs query uses `workspace_id` from session but `org` from query param, we might be merging filters incorrectly. i've seen a similar bug where OR was used instead of AND in the SQL.
Tess H.: any recent PRs touching run-list search or the query builder? @Dan G. did you merge the dedupe/query-optimizer change last week?
Dan G.: yeah that PR touched paginateAndFilter, but I thought it was scoped. i'll roll it back locally and try to repro.
ops-bot: deploy job #deploy-774 started for service: console-api
Maya R.: repro is consistent for me on prod and staging. I can demo in 15m if someone wants to join.
Dan G.: looking quickly at code — `buildFilters()` has a branch that returns `filters = filters.concat(pinnedFilters)` without deduping keys. if pinnedFilters includes an org filter from a previous session it could override.
Jordan L.: that would explain stale orgs appearing. pinnedFilters come from cookie->server side feature, right?
Sam T.: pinnedFilters are read from user prefs table and merged server-side when `use_pinned_filters=true`. if cookie flips, you can get cross-org.
Tess H.: short term: can we hard-block pinnedFilters from being merged when `org_id` param is present? that would be a quick guard.
Dan G.: yep i'll push a hotfix to skip pinnedFilters on any explicit org filter. will monitor.
Maya R.: thanks. also filing an infra alert so SRE can watch for anomalous telemetry (org mismatches in query logs).
ops-bot: incident-watcher created ticket #INC-2983 for console-org-filtering-anomaly
Jordan L.: long-term we should add an assertion in the query builder tests that filter keys must be unique and that explicit params trump persisted prefs.
Sam T.: agreed. i'll add test and a small audit to find any other places we merge client prefs into server queries.
Maya R.: appreciate it folks. ping me if you need access to the repro workspace. :thumbsup:
